title: McMoneagle's CIA remote viewing of Mars a million years ago

tellings.quote: who was tasked by the CIA to remote view Mars a million years ago and described giant beings.

plain: A former soldier named Joe McMoneagle, who worked as a remote viewer, someone said to describe distant places and times by mind alone, was tasked by the CIA to remote view Mars a million years ago, and he described giant beings there. Michels mentions this in passing in an episode about giants, apparently drawing on what McMoneagle has said on other interviews, including with the podcaster Shawn Ryan. If true, it would mean the CIA used psychics to look at ancient life on another planet.
